children: Home electrical, done right and to code
Licensed, insured, and tidy about it. Panel upgrades, outlets and lighting, ceiling fans, troubleshooting and whole-home safety — booked online in about a minute.

children: Every job runs under a licensed electrician and full insurance — so the work is safe, warrantied and yours to trust.
You get a clear written price before we start. No surprise line items, no "while we were in there" add-ons.
When a job needs a permit or an inspection, we pull it and see it through. It’s done to code, on paper as well as in the wall.
We use drop cloths, wipe down, and haul off the old parts. You’d never know we were there — except that it finally works.

children: Safety first — every visit, every time

Before we touch a thing, we check what’s already there: the panel, the grounding, the outlets on the circuit we’re working. Old wiring and quiet problems are how small jobs turn into big ones, so we find them early.
You get a straight answer about what’s safe, what can wait, and what shouldn’t — and a written note of anything we spot. No scare tactics, no upsell. Just the facts and a fair price.

pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who Brightwire Electric is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A tidy, labeled breaker panel after an upgrade

children: We started Brightwire because too many homeowners had been talked down to, overcharged, or left with work that wasn’t safe. We wanted to be the electrician you’d recommend to your own parents.

That means licensed, insured work, a clear price before we start, and leaving your home cleaner than we found it. If it needs a permit, we pull it. If it can wait, we’ll tell you. Straight answers, every time.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: You’ll always know what’s wrong, what we’re doing about it, and why — in plain language, before we start.
You approve a written price before any work begins. What we quote is what you pay.
Grounding, GFCI/AFCI protection, permits and inspections — the parts you can’t see are the ones we care about most.
